values.note: ReserveAmerica sells 89 sites: 45 standard non-electric, 1 RV/trailer non-electric, 14 pop-up/tent and 29 tent-only. 21 back-in sites are rated 23 ft or more (24-35 ft), concentrated on Kenny Rd (sites 60-67) and Sargent Rd; the rest are 14-22 ft.

note: MA DCR state forest in East Otis, on a wooded peninsula in the 1,065-acre Otis Reservoir: campers-only beach, boat ramp (boats up to 24 ft), trout and bass fishing. Black bear country: food lockers at every site. No visitors, registered campers only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: $17/$54, no hookups, no dump station, flush toilets + showers, reservations required (no walk-ins, no visitors), season mid-May to mid-Oct (5/14-10/11), phone 413-269-6002, 93 sites. Added max 35 (mass.gov 'RV sites have a 35-foot driveway'; RA 21 sites rated 24-35 ft), back-in only, 14-day limit, RA booking url. Note cleaned of field facts. Lakefront kept; see flag.
